name: HTML Table Generator
summary: Build an HTML table with headers, alignment, caption, and accessibility attributes — then copy the markup.
description: Edit a visual grid and get clean HTML with optional thead/tbody, scope="col", caption, border, CSS class, and column alignment. Paste TSV to import. Preview updates live; nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Is the preview safe?
faqs.answer: Cell values are HTML-escaped in the generated markup, so angle brackets in your data become entities.

faqs.question: What does scope="col" do?
faqs.answer: It marks header cells as column headers for assistive technology when accessibility mode is on.

faqs.question: Can I import a spreadsheet snippet?
faqs.answer: Yes — use Paste TSV with a tab-separated first header row and data rows.
